core: Triglyceride and lipid droplet storage and turnover
qualifier: with glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and fructose metabolism
name: Triglyceride and lipid droplet turnover with glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover acylglycerol synthesis and lipolysis, lipid droplet formation/fusion/lipophagy and adipose triglyceride storage control, and unlike the insulin/thermogenesis, adipocyte-transcription, fatty acid oxidation and phospholipid-remodelling confusables they include glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, alditol and fructose metabolism.

qualifier: autocrine and paracrine cytokine action
name: Macrophage CSF1 signaling and autocrine/paracrine cytokine action
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF/CSF1 receptor signaling, macrophage proliferation and interleukin receptor SHC/other interleukin signaling, and the theme is set apart from myeloid activation, CSF production, IL-6 and DAP12 confusables by autocrine/paracrine signaling and SIRP interactions.

qualifier: checkpoint control of phase transitions
name: Checkpoint control of meiotic cell cycle phase transitions
rationale: All members regulate progression through meiosis (G2/MI entry, metaphase/anaphase transition, checkpoint signaling, restraint of nuclear division and chromosome separation), whereas confusables cover the mechanics of meiotic cohesion, chiasma, spindle and chromosome segregation.

qualifier: anterior-posterior guidance of monoaminergic and sensory neurons
name: Anterior-posterior axon guidance of monoaminergic and sensory neurons
rationale: Members share axon guidance with repulsion/restraint of extension, and distinctively name serotonergic and dopaminergic axon guidance, anterior/posterior guidance and dorsal root ganglion development, absent from the commissural, netrin/semaphorin and sprouting confusables.

core: Quiescence entry and cell cycle exit during differentiation
qualifier: retinoid receptor, BMP/TGF-beta and PAX3 control
name: Differentiation-linked quiescence with retinoid and BMP signaling
rationale: Members concern G1-to-G0 transition and growth arrest (FOXO, p75NTR, p15/BMP modules) coupled to differentiation via retinoic acid receptor regulation and PAX3 targets, which distinguishes the theme from thyroid-receptor, ALK/PTEN/CDH1 transcription and p53 cell-cycle-arrest confusables.

core: Mitochondrial pyruvate oxidation and TCA cycle
qualifier: with coenzyme A biosynthesis and Fe-S cluster support
name: Pyruvate oxidation, TCA cycle and coenzyme A biosynthesis
rationale: Members span PDH-mediated acetyl-CoA formation, TCA intermediates, succinate dehydrogenase and ATP synthesis, distinguished from the OGDH/lipoylation/lysine and malate-aspartate shuttle/transport confusables by pantothenate-CoA biosynthesis, PDH regulation and Fe-S cluster assembly.

core: Oxidative, nitrosative and ischemic stress responses
qualifier: control of peroxide- and hypoxia-induced apoptosis
name: Oxidative and ischemic stress responses and peroxide-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members are cellular responses to reactive oxygen/nitrogen species, H2S, ischemia and oxygen, plus regulation of H2O2-, oxidative- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis, distinct from the ferroptosis/iron, nitric oxide and respiration-regulation confusables.

core: Caspase-8 and RIPK1 regulated cell death
qualifier: triggered by death receptors and TLR3-TRIF, including necroptosis
name: Death receptor and TLR3-TRIF caspase-8 apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover Fas/TRAIL extrinsic apoptosis via procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP and BID, plus TRIF/TLR3- and microbe-modulated RIPK1 necroptosis, which separates the theme from T cell activation-induced death and TBK1/IRF3 confusables.

qualifier: biosynthesis with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor and MAO/COMT degradation
name: Monoamine biosynthesis and degradation with tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis
rationale: Members cover dopamine/catecholamine synthesis, serotonin metabolism, MAO and COMT degradation and BH4 cofactor synthesis, unlike confusables centred on neurotransmitter transport, reuptake and vesicle loading.

qualifier: atypical RHOBTB and Ral GTPases
name: Atypical RHOBTB and Ral small GTPase signaling
rationale: Most members concern GTPase cycles and activity (RHOBTB1-3, Ral, Rho effectors rhotekin/rhophilin, GTPase activation/inhibition), distinguishing the theme from Golgi-organizing, Rab/ARF, cell-surface localization and nuclear transport confusables; diphtheria toxin uptake and localization terms are peripheral.

qualifier: magnesium, inositol and phosphocreatine-ATP energy shuttle
name: Magnesium and inositol transport with phosphocreatine energy shuttle
rationale: Members are loosely united by solute handling (magnesium transport and homeostasis, inositol transport/metabolism) plus creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange, which distinguishes them from chloride, aquaporin and tight-junction confusables; calcium-independent adhesion is an outlier.

qualifier: retinol uptake and esterification defects impairing phototransduction
name: Vitamin A metabolism defects causing retinal phototransduction disease
rationale: Members are vitamin A metabolism and its disease events, specifically STRA6, LRAT and RDH12 loss-of-function defects of visual phototransduction, distinct from the rod/cone retinoid cycle and retinoic acid metabolism confusables.

core: Multiciliated cell differentiation and centriole amplification
qualifier: ependymal, brain ventricle and CSF flow context
name: Ependymal multiciliogenesis and brain ventricle CSF circulation
rationale: Members cover transcriptional control of multiciliogenesis, de novo centriole and basal body assembly, together with lateral/third ventricle development and CSF circulation, which the axoneme, left-right and primary-cilium confusables lack.

qualifier: triggered in the absence of ligand
name: Dependence receptor apoptosis in absence of ligand
rationale: Members concern caspase activation and extrinsic apoptosis by unliganded dependence receptors (NTRK3, NRAGE-JNK) and neuron survival control, distinguished from p75NTR/NGF, FOXO/neurodegeneration and anoikis confusables by ligand-absence signaling.

qualifier: inhibitory synapse assembly via gephyrin and GABA receptor clustering
name: Inhibitory synapse assembly and postsynaptic potential regulation
rationale: Members regulate excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic potentials and inhibitory synapse assembly via gephyrin and GABA-A receptor clustering, contrasting with presynaptic, neurexin/PSD-95 and NMDA-clustering confusables.

core: Transcription by RNA polymerases I, II and III
qualifier: including HIV Tat-regulated elongation and rRNA gene control
name: Transcription by RNA polymerases I-III and HIV Tat elongation
rationale: Members cover initiation, promoter escape, elongation and termination for Pol I (rRNA), Pol II (including HIV Tat pausing/elongation) and Pol III (tRNA, 5S, snRNA) plus MYC targets, whereas confusables emphasize RNA processing, splicing, ribosome assembly and chromatin.

core: Neural tube patterning and neuron fate specification
qualifier: spinal cord and midbrain dopaminergic neurons
name: Spinal cord and midbrain dopaminergic neuron specification
rationale: Members cover dorsoventral spinal patterning and motor/interneuron differentiation plus midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation and monoaminergic axon guidance, which the hindbrain and floor plate/notochord confusables lack.

qualifier: HDL and LDL
name: HDL and LDL particle remodeling
rationale: All members are HDL or LDL particle remodeling, while confusables concern chylomicron and VLDL assembly, remodeling and clearance.

qualifier: with di/tricarboxylate transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
name: Pyruvate oxidation, CoA synthesis and carboxylate transport shuttles
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated pyruvate oxidation, CoA biosynthesis and TCA intermediates together with pyruvate, succinate and tricarboxylate transport and the malate-aspartate shuttle, separating the theme from glutamate/nitrogen and electron-transport confusables.

qualifier: AMPA receptor regulation and diffusion trapping
name: AMPA receptor trapping in excitatory synaptic transmission
rationale: Members concern excitatory transmission and short-term plasticity with regulation of AMPA receptor activity and receptor diffusion trapping, which the kainate, presynaptic and GABA confusables lack.

core: T and B lymphocyte development and activation
qualifier: T follicular helper and germinal center B cell interaction
name: T-B lymphocyte activation and germinal center Tfh help
rationale: Members span thymocyte and T/B cell differentiation and activation, distinguished from BCR, thymic selection, B cell signature and TCR/CD28 confusables by ICOS costimulation, Tfh differentiation and germinal center B cell differentiation.

qualifier: ribonucleoside and guanine
name: Purine ribonucleoside and guanine salvage
rationale: All members concern purine salvage, specifically ribonucleoside salvage and guanine metabolism, unlike confusables covering nucleobase/IMP salvage and purine catabolism.

qualifier: including mineralocorticoid and aldosterone control
name: Adrenal glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid and androgen biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid and androgen synthesis and their CYP enzyme deficiencies, distinguished from confusables by aldosterone synthesis, secretion and regulation.

qualifier: dystrophin complex and neuromuscular junction assembly
name: Muscle fiber basement membrane and neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members cover laminin/proteoglycan basement membrane assembly, the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, AChR clustering at the NMJ and myofiber differentiation, unlike collagen, DAG1 glycosylation and sarcomere confusables.

qualifier: late sterol steps and oxysterol bile acid routes
name: Late cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol-derived bile acid formation
rationale: Members cover post-zymosterol Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis and its catabolism via 24- and 27-hydroxycholesterol to bile acids, including CYP27A1/CYP7B1/CYP2U1 spastic paraplegia defects, distinct from 7alpha-hydroxy bile acid, mevalonate and peroxisomal oxidation confusables.
